name: awesome-claude-code
summary: A curated list of resources for Claude Code, organised into sections such as skills, agents, plugins, status lines, developer tooling, security and memory persistence. It works as a directory to browse, not a single skill.
install_steps: See the repository README for install steps
example_use_case: You want a ready-made skill for a recurring task, so you open the Skills section of the list, compare the options, and follow the link to the one that fits.
